title: 脑裂与 min-replicas-to-write 防护：分区时主节点停写
expected_output:
=== 脑裂与 min-replicas 防护模拟 ===
正常: 从节点 lag=2 <= 10, 健康从节点数=1 >= min_replicas(1)
主节点可写: True
脑裂分区: 从节点 lag=999 > 10, 健康从节点数=0
min-replicas-to-write 触发 -> 主节点拒绝写入(MINREPLICAS), 宁可停写也不制造分叉
分区恢复后: 旧主已停写, 不出现双主数据分叉
code:
print("=== 脑裂与 min-replicas 防护模拟 ===")
min_replicas = 1
max_lag = 10
replicas = [{"lag": 2}]
healthy = [r for r in replicas if r["lag"] <= max_lag]
can_write = len(healthy) >= min_replicas
print("正常: 从节点 lag=%d <= %d, 健康从节点数=%d >= min_replicas(%d)" % (replicas[0]["lag"], max_lag, len(healthy), min_replicas))
print("主节点可写:", can_write)
replicas = [{"lag": 999}]
healthy = [r for r in replicas if r["lag"] <= max_lag]
can_write = len(healthy) >= min_replicas
print("脑裂分区: 从节点 lag=%d > %d, 健康从节点数=%d" % (replicas[0]["lag"], max_lag, len(healthy)))
if not can_write:
    print("min-replicas-to-write 触发 -> 主节点拒绝写入(MINREPLICAS), 宁可停写也不制造分叉")
else:
    print("主节点继续写入")
print("分区恢复后: 旧主已停写, 不出现双主数据分叉")
